title: Resolve a conflict
brief: main and feature both rewrote app.txt. Merge feature into main: git will stop at the conflict and mark the file. Open app.txt from the working tree panel, decide the final text, delete the marker lines, then stage and commit.

diagnostics.say: app.txt carries conflict markers. Click it in the working tree panel, keep the final text, and delete every line starting with <<<<<<<, =======, or >>>>>>>. Then git add app.txt and commit.

hints: Start with git merge feature. Git stops and marks app.txt.
Click app.txt in the working tree panel to open the editor. The final content is your decision.
Save, then: git add app.txt, git commit -m "merge main and feature".
